title: System Overview
markdown:
Open Executive is a multi-agent system presenting a single executive persona to the user while a council of domain specialists works behind it. Clients and integration channels reach a FastAPI backend, which drives the `Executive` orchestrator (`openexecutive.orchestrator.executive`). The internal sub-agent architecture is never exposed — there is one voice.

### Topology

- **Clients** — the Next.js web UI plus inbound integration channels (email, Slack, Discord, Telegram) all enter through the FastAPI API layer (`POST /chat` streams the live turn as server-sent events).
- **Orchestrator** — the `Executive` runs an Anthropic tool-use loop. For cross-domain questions it emits multiple parallel `consult_specialist` tool calls that fan out concurrently via `openexecutive.orchestrator.router.route_parallel`, bounded by `MAX_PARALLEL_SPECIALISTS`.
- **Specialists** — eight consult-routable domain agents (cso, cfo, cmo, coo, chro, cpo, gc, sales). Each runs its own domain-filtered ChromaDB query before seeing the question, so retrieval is scoped per declared domain alias.
- **Knowledge layer** — ChromaDB holds curated `BUILTIN` knowledge, ingested `COMPANY` documents, recorded `FAILURES`, and `RECENT_RESEARCH` artifacts; SQLite backs sessions, audit, departments, and people.

The Executive synthesizes all specialist input into one coherent reply. LLM calls resolve per-call through `openexecutive.providers.get_provider(model)`, defaulting to the Anthropic SDK with Anthropic prompt caching on the system blocks. Setting `OPENROUTER_ENABLED` routes calls through OpenRouter, and `LOCAL_MODELS_ENABLED` routes the slugs listed in `LOCAL_MODELS` to a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) via the same provider seam — so `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` becomes optional when one of those is configured.

### Solo or team

An install runs in one of two modes, stored with the user's time zone in `openexecutive.memory.workspace_settings` (`GET`/`PUT /workspace`). **Team** (the default) is a company with departments and people. **Solo** is one person using Open Executive just for themselves — a business owner, an executive inside a larger organisation, or an independent — and the same settings hold that person's role (kind, title, reports to, remit, measured on), which the Executive and its specialists fit their advice to: department check-ins do not run, while the department rows are kept so switching back is instant. The user's zone (else `USER_TIMEZONE`, else UTC) sets when the morning brief, end-of-day digest and reflection fire, and the zone the Executive resolves "tomorrow at 9" in.

### As itself — and, when you ask, as you

The Executive has an identity of its own: its own Google account (`EXEC_EMAIL_ADDRESS`), its own chat bots, and it signs as itself — an identity addendum in the cached persona block forbids writing in anyone else's name. **Act as me** (`openexecutive.delegation`, off by default) is the one opt-in exception: the principal can let it write email *as them*, in their own voice, saved as a draft in their own Gmail for them to review and send. It is offered only on their own verified turn in a conversation private to them, reaches their mailbox through a typed client that is never registered with the MCP gateway, and never sends. See **Act as Me (Delegation)**.
